blind.table_distance_name: shrouded corpse on a stone slab
blind.description: A stone mortuary slab or embalming table supported on two thick carved stone pedestal legs with recessed arches. On top rests a human figure completely wrapped in a pale, sculpted fabric shroud with realistic drapery and folds, lying supine with the head resting against a low stone headrest block at one end and a small drainage spout extending past the foot end. The draped cloth spills slightly over the rim of the table. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and fully contiguous with no floating parts or defects. The legs sit flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: A rectangular stone rimmed frame containing a shrouded human corpse lying flat, showing the outlines of the head, torso, and legs under cloth, with a small rectangular headrest block at the right end and a small drain protrusion on the left edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: Height reaches approximately mid-thigh or knee level on the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2 to 2.5 ft tall); length is roughly 6 to 6.5 ft long, slightly longer than the figure is tall, and about 2.5 ft wide.
